create_grid_env: create a GridEnv instance to maintain relative goal position in a grid world
reset_grid_env_goal: reset the GridEnv with a goal offset list containing x, y, and theta values
generate_goal_images: generate multi-scale goal map images using bilinear interpolation from goal distance and theta
take_grid_action: take a discrete action in the GridEnv to move forward or rotate left or right
get_grid_features: get goal images and incremental pose features from the GridEnv for policy input
